Overview

About the game

What UndeadOverhaul is right now — honest, in-progress, and built in the open.

UndeadOverhaul is a two-person indie game project. EryyynIT handles the code and engineering, BreadCatto handles the visual side. We're building it in the open — progress and devlogs land on the official Telegram channel.
